result.stdout:
nadel builds the stories and assets of Faden games.

Commands:
  init       Starts a new game project: its project file, a first script, the folders of its assets and a
             program that plays it.
               --name <name>                  The name of the project, by default the name of the folder.
               --output <directory>           Where it is written, by default here.
               --kind <kind>                  novel, which is the default, or sandbox.
               --version <version>            The version of the Faden packages it references.
               --engine <directory>           A Faden repository to reference instead of the packages.
  build      Updates the text lock and the catalogs, checks the story and packs it when the check finds no
             error, taking the scripts, assets, declarations, locales and key from a game project or from
             the options that pack takes.
               --project <file or directory>  A game project, or a folder of scripts with an assets folder.
               --entry <node>                 A node the game starts at. Repeatable, start by default.
               --output <file>                The pack file to write.
             It also takes every option of pack, while those given by --project cannot be given again.
  pack       Compiles the scripts and translations, encodes images for the graphics card and audio with
             ffmpeg when it is installed, and packs everything with the assets into one file.
               --scripts <file or directory>  A script, or a directory searched for .faden files. Repeatable.
               --assets <directory>           A directory of assets. Repeatable.
               --locales <directory>          The directory holding lines.lock.json and the .po catalogs.
               --declarations <file or dir>   The C# files declaring the world state and the commands.
               --output <file>                The pack file to write.
               --key <file>                   A key written b
